subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Which core-owned contract should let the Microsoft Teams plugin request lifecycle reset of a session physically owned by another harness plugin?
rationale: Teams owns the observable external removal signal, but the existing scoped runtime correctly permits physical-owner release only from the harness-owning plugin; selecting the authorized cross-owner orchestration boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add core reset orchestration
options.body: Expose a narrow core-owned request that resolves and invokes the registered harness owner before atomically rotating the persisted session.

options.title: Accept unlocked-only resets
options.body: Merge with an explicit limitation that locked harness-owned Teams sessions may retain prior context after app removal.

options.title: Delegate lifecycle to harness plugins
options.body: Require every harness owner to consume channel lifecycle events, coupling harness implementations to transport-specific policy.

recommendation.title: Add core reset orchestration
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow core-owned request that resolves and invokes the registered harness owner before atomically rotating the persisted session.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, and their commits already shaped the lifecycle scope and public reset boundary.
